title: Pin-change quality sentinels — automated sampling, evaluation, and alerts for catalog and customer pins
creator: Aisha Kumar
description:
Objective: Automatically trigger targeted evaluations and sampling jobs whenever a model version is pinned or upgraded (both catalog-level defaults and customer-pinned overrides). The goal is to detect quality regressions early, provide actionable diagnostics, and surface guarded rollbacks or canary hold-outs.

Scope:
- Triggered on: catalog model version pin, customer project pin, pin upgrades via API/Console, and programmatic pins from infra rolls.
- Run types: lightweight smoke suite (latency & hallucination checks), sample-based end-to-end evals (100-1k examples depending on traffic), and regression delta metrics against baseline.
- Output: pass/fail sentinel, metric deltas (ROUGE/BLEU/EMBED sim, safety scores), top-failed prompt examples, and suggested rollback if regression > threshold.

Requirements:
1) Non-blocking default: trigger must not increase request latency or block pin operation.
2) Configurable per-customer: allow customers to opt-out, tune sample size, and set alert thresholds.
3) Tie to rollout policies: integrate with rollout engine to pause canaries or auto-fallback when critical regressions detected.
4) Observability: per-pin dashboard, historical regressions, and audit trail linking pin events to eval results.
5) Cost controls: cap eval budget and fallback to smoke tests when budget exhausted.

Deliverables:
- API/Console flag to enable/disable auto-evals and configure profiles.
- Server-side orchestration that schedules eval jobs asynchronously and stores results in eval-store.
- Alerting rules for severity levels and automatic rollback triggers.
- UX in Console to view sample failures, re-run evals, and approve pin to skip the guard.

Assumptions:
- We can reuse existing eval harness and datasets maintained by Evals team.
- ENG will provide an event webhook for pin events or work with model-catalog to emit them.

Out of scope:
- Building new synthetic datasets for every model family (follow-up project).
acceptance_criteria: Pin event creates an eval job visible in the eval queue within 60s
Smoke-suite returns pass/fail and latency metrics within 10 minutes for 95% of runs
Configured threshold breach triggers an alert to the pin owner and pauses canary rollout
Console shows top 10 failing prompts and a link to the full eval report
Customers can toggle auto-eval at project level
